findings.text: The hash query and arity query expose type information for a function address. The hash query adjusts the address by a mode specific amount then performs a fault tolerant read, returning zero when the mode is unsupported or the read fails. The arity query is active only when fine grained checking or branch history mitigation is enabled, deriving a count from a displacement stored just before the entry relative to a dedicated argument table, returning zero otherwise or on fault.

The fine grained trap decoder classifies a faulting processor state into paranoid, branch history, or preamble cases. On success it produces a target address and a type value and adjusts the instruction pointer when the fault lies mid instruction, returning true. On mismatch or faulty memory it returns false without side effects beyond outputs.

Module application forwards site ranges to the internal fine grained implementation with builtin indication cleared, so no fresh seed is generated and no informational logging occurs. The full internal version orchestrates mode selection and rewriting for builtin and module ranges, while the fallback version only reports standard kernel checking when enabled for builtin and otherwise does nothing.

Supervisor tracking helpers capture and restore indirect branch enforcement state. Save reads the control register only when the feature is present and optionally clears the enforcement bit, returning the prior value. Restore rereads the register, preserves all bits except enforcement from the saved value, and writes back. Both helpers are exempt from enforcement themselves to allow safe transition.

Non maskable control helpers manipulate a shared ignore counter. One increments the counter to suppress handling around code patching, the other decrements to reallow handling. They provide no other synchronization and rely on the caller to balance calls.

Builtin call patching initializes call depth tracking for core text. It does nothing unless the tracking feature is enabled, otherwise it logs initiation, serializes setup with the text mutex, delegates to the range walker with the builtin descriptor, records completion, and releases the mutex.

Randomization is enabled by default with a seed that becomes immutable after initialization. Rehashing mixes the seed by exclusive or then iteratively transforms the result to avoid values that would encode as branch end markers in either polarity, using shift and conditional mixing with a fixed polynomial constant, guaranteeing the final hash never collides with marker encoding.

Boot control accepts a comma separated list selecting mode and diagnostics. Recognized selectors include automatic, disabled, debug logging, kernel checking, fine grained checking, disabling randomization, and non fatal warnings. Paranoid and branch history selectors only take effect when fine grained mode is already selected, otherwise they are ignored with an error. Unknown selectors are logged and ignored, and null input is rejected.

A decoded caller value of zero signals absence of checking and causes all caller walks to leave the site untouched. Nonzero values are preserved across disabling so later stages can reuse the original type information without redecoding from compiler metadata.

Preamble rewriting skips functions lacking a branch end marker at the expected offset, leaving them without checking. For others it installs a template so the tail aligns with function entry even when the surrounding prefix is larger than usual. Old markers are poisoned only on exact match after no caller targets the original entry, ensuring no live target is removed prematurely.

Rewriting validates assumed byte lengths before proceeding, including preamble and caller and paranoid lengths plus the combined branch history footprint and a minimum offset requirement. Any mismatch aborts the whole operation without partial patching, protecting against compiler layout drift.

Site ranges are tables of signed displacements where each entry is resolved by adding the stored value to the address of the entry itself. Caller related walks then step back by a fixed caller length to reach the patch point, while preamble walks use the resolved address directly with a fixed prefix adjustment for placement.

Branch history customization is inactive for zero arity. Single argument functions without warnings use a compact single slot form, while other arities install a short call sequence targeting a per arity handler. Decoding succeeds only when mitigation is enabled and the faulting address lies within the handler table, using the stack return slot as the true target.

Paranoid handling is active only when its flag is set. Trap recognition derives the target from a dedicated address register plus a fixed prefix distance and the type from the accumulator. Thunk recognition uses a low byte pattern check. Rewriting requires the following operation to be a direct call or long jump and chooses between trampoline and plain indirect emission based on processor mitigation need.

Self tests enforce exact outcomes. The breakpoint path must yield a specific counter value after emulated call completion, and the relocation path must receive the address of a dedicated initialization data integer. Deviations raise fatal or warning diagnostics indicating patching or emulation failure.

Builtin call patching holds the text mutex across the entire range setup and releases it after marking completion. No other locking is shown for preamble, caller, or alternative walks, which rely on boot single threading and interrupt suppression instead.

Boot patching brackets all rewriting between suppression and reallowance of non maskable interrupts via a shared counter, assuming peer processors are stopped and local patching is not atomic. Machine checks are intentionally left enabled so corruption is not hidden, accepting a small race over silent data loss.

Indirect branch enforcement is cleared before fine grained and retpoline rewriting and restored afterwards, allowing intermediate states where callers and callees use different checking forms to execute safely. The save value preserves the prior enable state for exact restoration.

The preamble is a contiguous byte range bounded by start and end markers. A type hash resides at a small fixed offset from the start, a branch history customization point lives at a computed offset, a trap displacement is fixed, and the usable prefix length equals the total length minus the branch end instruction size.

The caller sequence is a bounded range with its type value near the start and a short jump displacement derived from the total length minus two. The paranoid sequence is a bounded range with an indirect emission point at a computed offset and a trap at a fixed distance. The single slot branch history fragment is likewise a bounded start to end range.

Decoders consume processor state consisting of instruction pointer, stack pointer, accumulator, a dedicated address register, and the stack return slot. They produce a fault target address and a type value, updating the instruction pointer when the fault lies in the middle of an instruction.

Call site collections pair start and end pointers into a displacement table with a core text descriptor identifying the region name. Iteration resolves each table entry to an absolute address for decoding and conditional redirection, using the descriptor to test membership of callers and destinations.

Automatic mode resolves to kernel checking by default or to fine grained checking when hardware tracking is present, enabling paranoid handling unless a fast exception facility is present. All flows first disable checking, optionally randomize with a fresh seed for builtin including special hashes, then diverge to disabled return or re enable or fine grained rewrite of preambles then callers then removal of old markers. Any rewrite failure ends in a logged severe error without checking.

Boot patching follows a fixed order. It self tests breakpoints, suppresses non maskable interrupts, sets paravirt capabilities, suspends indirect branch enforcement, applies fine grained checking and clears debug output, rewrites retpolines then returns, finalizes indirect target mitigation, adjusts builtin calls, applies alternatives, seals unreferenced markers, restores enforcement, reallows interrupts, marks completion, and tests relocations.

Boot option words transition global mode and boolean flags for randomization, debug output, non fatal warnings, paranoid handling, and branch history handling. Disabling clears randomization. Paranoid and branch history words only take effect when mode is already fine grained, otherwise they are ignored. Unknown words leave all state unchanged.

Early initialization entry performs all code patching and self verification while peer processors are stopped. It coordinates fine grained checking, retpoline and return rewriting, call adjustment, alternative patching, and marker sealing under interrupt suppression and enforcement suspension.

Breakpoint notifier entry filters for kernel mode breakpoints at the self test location. On match it emulates a call to the test callee and terminates the notification chain, otherwise it passes through. The self test registers this notifier last then unregisters after verification.

Visible initialization target validates relocation handling by checking that its argument equals the address of a dedicated test integer. It is invoked through an alternative sequence combining an address load with a direct call to exercise relocation patching.

Once callers are disabled, any later stage failure leaves the system running without indirect call checking. The error path only logs a severe message, so callers must treat rewrite errors as fatal to security posture rather than retryable.

Patching is not fully atomic and relies on suppressed local interrupts and stopped peers. Machine checks remain enabled by design, so a genuine corruption event during patching could execute partially updated code, which is preferred over hiding the corruption.

All hash and target reads use fault tolerant access that fails safely on bad memory. Preamble faults and certain paranoid thunk faults leave the instruction pointer in the middle of an instruction and require manual redirection, while branch history faults and exact trapped operations can use normal fixup due to trailing return or precise trap location.

Missing type values trigger warnings and abort rewriting, indicating compiler output or layout drift. Template installation expects a specific placeholder value and warns on mismatch, so unexpected compiler thunks or alignment changes can halt checking enablement.

Call redirection silently skips sites outside expected text, non call opcodes, skipped destinations, and allocation failures. Decode errors are propagated as error pointers checked by the caller, so silent skips are normal for patched out or foreign calls and must not be treated as failures.

Supervisor tracking control is read and written directly and must preserve unrelated bits while touching hardware only when the feature is present. The save and restore helpers themselves are exempt from enforcement to avoid self faults during transition, and mismatched save restore pairing would leave enforcement in the wrong state.
Preamble trap displacement is nineteen from the start and preamble hash offset is five from the start.
Caller hash immediate offset is one from the caller start, and caller short jump displacement equals caller total length minus two.
Paranoid trap displacement is thirteen from the sequence start.
Validated byte lengths are twenty for preamble, twenty for paranoid, twenty for combined branch history footprint, and fourteen for caller.
Template placeholder value is 305419896 decimal and self test expected counter is 4660 decimal.
Rehash mixing polynomial constant is 2149580803 decimal, applied on odd intermediate values during marker avoidance iteration.
Self test breakpoint notifier priority is one less than the maximum integer value, ensuring it runs last in the chain.
First group of boot selectors uses auto and off and debug and kcfi and fineibt.
Second group uses norand and warn and paranoid and bhi, with the last two requiring fine grained mode and the branch history word also requiring build support.
Re enable trailer uses four byte values 117 and 1 and 168 and 214 decimal, and the mov prefix uses 65 and 186 decimal.
Paranoid thunk recognition masks with 16777215 decimal and compares against 16610774 decimal.
